_about: Acceptance thresholds used by the analysis scripts under benchmarks/cases/.
The project's own validation protocol (EM_EB_MHD_VALIDATION_10CASES_v2.md:196) asks for these
to be committed BEFORE the first run. They were not: they were written after the first runs,
from the observed scatter (finding Benchmarks/F13). This file records that honestly instead of
pretending the numbers are a-priori. A threshold marked provenance='post-hoc' cannot by itself
exclude a result that was tuned until it passed; 'replacement' says what would remove the doubt.

gates.name: tol_single (per-probe |r| band)
gates.measured: per-probe ratio modulated by +/-10-17% (diffraction off the PML-truncated plane)
gates.replacement: report the beam-mean only, and require the per-probe spread to shrink with plane width; the 0.20 band would no longer be needed

gates.name: tol_mean (beam mean)
gates.measured: mean deviation across the probe set
gates.replacement: convergence in n_cell: error must fall monotonically over two refinements

gates.name: |r+1|
gates.replacement: fit r(n_cell) and require the fit's slope to be negative (converging to -1)

gates.name: energy growth
gates.measured: no run showed growth; the bound only has to exclude blow-up
gates.replacement: none needed: this is an explicit blow-up detector, not a physics accuracy gate

gates.name: amplitude ratio
gates.measured: measured ratio well inside the band
gates.replacement: compare against the analytic Mie series (analyze_mie_convergence.py does this and is the reference analysis)

gates.name: slope error
gates.measured: delta relative error at the shipped resolution
